what: Grab is Southeast Asia's super app: ride hailing, food delivery, grocery delivery, payments and lending, in eight countries including Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam.
customers: Consumers across Southeast Asia, the drivers and restaurants on its platform, and borrowers using its financial services.
moat: Drivers, restaurants and users all in one app across eight countries: each side makes the others more valuable, and a new entrant has to build all three at once.
risks: $2.93 a share with analysts averaging $5.39: a 84% gap means wide disagreement about the value
Free cash flow was slightly negative as the lending business grew its loan book
Regulation of ride hailing and digital lending varies by country and can change quickly
opportunities: Revenue grew from $675M to $3.4B in four years and turned profitable at $587M of net income
The digital bank and lending arm monetise users the delivery business already has
watch: On-demand gross merchandise value growth and whether financial services keep scaling.
